final: WITH event_avgs AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS event_avg FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget), kept AS (SELECT e.link_to_event, e.event_avg, e.event_avg - o.avg_amount AS global_diff FROM event_avgs e CROSS JOIN overall_avg o WHERE e.event_avg > o.avg_amount), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(event_avg) AS avg_event_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.link_to_event, k.event_avg, k.global_diff, k.event_avg - a.avg_event_avg AS diff_from_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_avg a ORDER BY diff_from_kept_avg DESC LIMIT 10
